sequence.note: Launch defaults (Owner, 2026-11-11): email touches stay off until the Owner turns batch approval on; a cold lead gets two touches, day 0 and about day 5; email only to an address that opted in. leads.max_touches_per_lead stays the lifetime cap of three.

dm_door.note: v2: one door for every DM. Venues use it with niche venue. DM links carry area, channel and niche, never persona.
